title: CDP port isolation: SHA256 4-port block per project CWD
desc: CDP isolation scheme 2026-05-08: SHA256-based deterministic 4-port block per project, foreign Chrome rejection, CWD-hash sandbox keys, live position computation.
steps:
PORT: DerivePort(root) = SHA256(path.lower())[0:4] uint32 % 174 * 4 + 9300. Always & 0xFFFC aligned. 174 blocks x 4 ports in 9300-9995.
ROOT: ProjectRoot.Find(parentProcessCWD) -- not raw CWD. Claude moves to subdirs; git root is stable identity. Read via GetParentProcessId + GetProcessCurrentDirectory (NtQueryInformationProcess).
BLOCK: ports [base..base+3] belong to one project. Collision tries remaining 3 slots. All 4 taken = hard error (intentional).
FOREIGN REJECT: (1) FindRunningChromePortAny: registered=0 means skip (0!=port). (2) WebOpenCommand: reject if (found&0xFFFC)!=(derived&0xFFFC). (3) explicit --port: AppBotExit(1) if outside block.
SANDBOX KEY: BuildSandboxKey uses SHA256(callerCWD)[0:4] not HWND. Format: cmd+host+cwdHash4. Stable across sessions unlike HWND.
POSITION: always pass --window-position to Chrome. CallerHwnd latched=caller-offset. No latch=ExpectedBounds top-right. ComputePlacementNearCaller() null=no reposition. No geometry file persistence.
